mapper.sql: work.organization_uuid, work.workspace_uuid, s.external_id AS session_external_id, COALESCE(cs.external_id, '') AS code_session_external_id, COALESCE(CAST(cs.uuid AS text), '') AS code_session_uuid, sandbox.uuid AS sandbox_uuid, sandbox.provider_sandbox_id, sandbox.state, sandbox.stop_reason

FROM environment_work work JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = work.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid JOIN environment_sandboxes sandbox ON sandbox.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND sandbox.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid AND sandbox.environment_uuid = work.environment_uuid AND sandbox.work_uuid = work.uuid LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT code.uuid, code.external_id, code.status, code.deleted_at, code.worker_status, code.idle_since FROM code_sessions code WHERE code.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND code.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid AND code.environment_uuid = work.environment_uuid AND code.session_uuid = work.session_uuid ORDER BY code.created_at DESC, code.uuid DESC LIMIT 1 ) cs ON true
work.organization_uuid = #{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND work.workspace_uuid = #{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND sandbox.uuid = #{scope.SandboxUUID} AND sandbox.provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE work.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND work.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND work.session_uuid = #{sessionUUID} AND s.archived_at IS NOT NULL AND sandbox.provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL AND sandbox.state = 'stopping' AND sandbox.stop_reason = 'session_archived' ORDER BY sandbox.uuid
SELECT WHERE FOR UPDATE OF work, sandbox
mapper.update: UPDATE code_sessions cs SET current_worker_epoch = current_worker_epoch + 1, worker_lease_expires_at = NULL, oauth_access_token_hash = NULL, connection_status = 'disconnected', updated_at = NOW() WHERE cs.uuid = #{codeSessionUUID} AND cs.status = 'active' AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL AND cs.worker_status = 'idle' AND cs.idle_since <= #{cutoff} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s JOIN environments env ON env.uuid = s.environment_uuid AND env.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid AND env.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid WHERE s.uuid = cs.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND s.status = 'idle' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND env.config->>'type' = 'cloud') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM environment_work work JOIN environment_sandboxes sandbox ON sandbox.work_uuid = work.uuid AND sandbox.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND sandbox.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid AND sandbox.environment_uuid = work.environment_uuid WHERE sandbox.uuid = #{sandboxUUID} AND sandbox.state = 'running' AND work.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND work.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND work.environment_uuid = cs.environment_uuid AND work.session_uuid = cs.session_uuid AND work.state = 'active' AND work.deleted_at IS NULL)

WITH stopping_work AS ( UPDATE environment_work work SET state = 'stopped', stop_requested_at = COALESCE(work.stop_requested_at, NOW()), stopped_at = COALESCE(work.stopped_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() FROM sessions s JOIN environments env ON env.uuid = s.environment_uuid AND env.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid AND env.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid WHERE work.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND work.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND work.session_uuid = #{sessionUUID} AND s.uuid = work.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid AND s.archived_at IS NOT NULL AND env.config->>'type' = 'cloud' RETURNING work.uuid ) UPDATE environment_sandboxes SET state = 'stopping', stop_reason = 'session_archived', updated_at = NOW() WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND work_uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM stopping_work) AND provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL AND state <> 'stopped'
